say:1:1321821001:1.text: Orla, we're back. How are you holding up?
say:1:1321821001:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，我们回来了……你还好吗？

say:2:1321821002:1.text: I... I really miss Papa and Mama... *Sob*

say:3:1321821003:1.text: We discovered who was responsible for your father's death—justice has been served.
say:3:1321821003:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，听着，我们找到了杀死你爸爸的凶手，也给你的爸爸...

say:4:1321821004:1.text: Thank you... but it still hurts... Without Papa, I'm all alone. No one cares about me anymore...
say:4:1321821004:1.source_cn: 嗯……我明白……谢谢你们。可是……爸爸走了，以后就没人...

say:5:1321821005:1.text: Here, I brought this for you from Cedartown. It's a special treat—why don't you try it? If you like it, I'll bring more next time.
say:5:1321821005:1.source_cn: 这是我从雪松镇买来的食物，拿着，尝尝看……如果你喜欢吃...

say:7:1321821007:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，不会没人管你的。

say:10:1321821009:3.text: My dear, don't get too close. We've just returned from a dangerous place—there may still be traces of dark magic on us.
say:10:1321821009:3.source_cn: 好孩子，别抱太紧，我们刚从危险的地方回来，可能身上还残...

narration:13:1321821012:1.text: Orla cries her heart out, clinging to Faramor as he quietly soothes her with his calming presence.

say:16:1321821013:1.text: Orla, may we speak for a moment?
say:16:1321821013:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，我们聊聊天好吗？

say:17:1321821014:1.text: You love your parents dearly. That must mean they were wonderful people.
say:17:1321821014:1.source_cn: 你的父亲和母亲……你那么爱他们，他们一定是很好的人吧？

say:18:1321821015:0.text: Yeah, they are the best parents in the world!
say:18:1321821015:0.source_cn: 嗯，他们是世界上最好的爸爸妈妈！

say:19:1321821016:1.text: Papa was a mailman, running around town delivering huge bags of letters every day.
say:19:1321821016:1.source_cn: 爸爸是一名邮差，他总是跑来跑去地给镇子里的人送邮件。那...

say:20:1321821017:1.text: And Mama used to work in the library! She was very knowledgeable and taught me many things, but I couldn't remember all of them.
say:20:1321821017:1.source_cn: 妈妈也很厉害，她当过我们镇子里的图书管理员呢！她懂得很...

say:21:1321821018:1.text: Did your mother ever tell you about your family name?
say:21:1321821018:1.source_cn: 那……你的妈妈有没有教过你家族姓氏？

say:22:1321821019:1.text: She did, and I remember it well! My father's surname is Wolkov, while my mother's is Ragna. My full name is Orla Ragna Wolkov.
say:22:1321821019:1.source_cn: 嗯！她教过的，我都记住了！我的爸爸姓沃尔科夫，妈妈姓罗...

say:24:1321821021:1.text: I bet you haven't had a proper rest in days. Why don't you get some sleep after finishing the food?
say:24:1321821021:1.source_cn: 好了，你一定很久都没有好好睡觉了吧？这样会累坏身体的。...

say:27:1321821023:1.text: Orla seems to have no connection to those hero families at first glance. There's no reason for the Hypogean minions to attack her father.
say:27:1321821023:1.source_cn: 看上去她和白山的几个家族并没有什么关系，但根据瓦丽卡女...

choice_prompt:28:1321821023.text: Orla seems to have no connection to those hero families at first glance. There's no reason for the Hypogean minions to attack her father.
choice_prompt:28:1321821023.source_cn: 看上去她和白山的几个家族并没有什么关系，但根据瓦丽卡女士的说法，恶魔眷属总是先会袭击那些参加过第一次神魔战争的家族血脉后裔。

say:29:1321821024:2.text: Hmm... Carolina is a descendant of the Radinov family, and Ludovic is from the Valesa family. They might know what to do.
say:29:1321821024:2.source_cn: 唔……卡列琳娜是拉季诺夫家的后裔，柳博米尔是瓦勒沙家的...

say:30:1321821026:1.text: Looks like we should invite Ludovic and Carolina here...
say:30:1321821026:1.source_cn: 看来得邀请柳博米尔先生和卡列琳娜女士前来……

say:31:1321821027:1.text: But the sight of two Graveborn in town might unsettle the people. Let's meet them somewhere quiet in the <style="highlight">west</style> instead. I'll bring Orla there.
say:31:1321821027:1.source_cn: 但两位亡灵进入雪松镇中可能会引起众人的恐慌，还是去<s...
say:31:1321821027:1.male: But the sight of two Graveborn in town might unsettle the people. Let's meet them somewhere quiet in the <style="highlight">west</style> instead. I'll bring Orla there.
say:31:1321821027:1.female: But the sight of two Graveborn in town might unsettle the people. Let's meet them somewhere quiet in the <style="highlight">west</style> instead. I'll bring Orla there.

say:33:1321821025:2.text: Unfortunately, bloodline magic isn't my area of expertise. We have to rely on the Graveborn this time.
say:33:1321821025:2.source_cn: 血脉法术可不是我的专长，不过亡灵应该对血脉法术比较有研究吧？

choice:28:1:2.text: There's got to be a spell.
choice:28:1:2.source_cn: 应该有能够确认血脉的法术
choice:28:1:2.male: There's got to be a spell.
choice:28:1:2.female: There's got to be a spell.

say:34:1321821011:2.text: Keep it down, Magister! Mr. Faramor might hear you!
say:34:1321821011:2.source_cn: 主人，小声点，不然法拉莫尔先生会听到的！
say:34:1321821011:2.male: Keep it down, Magister! Mr. Faramor might hear you!
say:34:1321821011:2.female: Keep it down, Magister! Mr. Faramor might hear you!

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 小孩子都喜欢抱着毛茸茸的大白狼吧……
